rationale: Adult female age band follows the existing REDWOOD reference. Filter on measured stature and measured span near the T56 canon target; do not select on desired limb results or silently expand an insufficient cohort.
statistics: Unweighted observed marginal median and linearly interpolated p05/p95. These are neither confidence intervals nor manufacturing tolerances.
shape_rule: Also show one actual cohort row nearest the marginal medians by summed relative absolute deviation, with source-row tie break; do not present independent percentile dimensions as one observed person.
legacy_comparison: Only the legacy reference numbers are scaled by H/1650 for comparison. Measured people are not rescaled. No legacy value is promoted to canon.
